keyEvents.text: Thiago Silvero (Vélez Sarsfield) is shown the red card.
Tomás Marchiori (Vélez Sarsfield) is shown the yellow card.
Joaquín Mosqueira (Unión Santa Fe) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Unión Santa Fe 1, Vélez Sarsfield 0. Cristian Tarragona (Unión Santa Fe) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Goal! Unión Santa Fe 2, Vélez Sarsfield 0. Cristian Tarragona (Unión Santa Fe) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Marcelo Estigarribia.
Mauro Luna Diale (Unión Santa Fe) is shown the yellow card for handball.
Substitution, Vélez Sarsfield. Leo Cristaldo replaces Juan Cruz Policella.
Tobías Rubio (Unión Santa Fe) is shown the yellow card.
First Half ends, Unión Santa Fe 2, Vélez Sarsfield 0.
